title: Credit Card Four-Key USB Macro Pad

GND.rationale: Two-layer return plane for USB power, display, keys, and analog audio.

VBUS.rationale: USB 5 V from the XIAO module and LCD backlight supply.

V3V3.rationale: XIAO-regulated 3.3 V logic and microphone rail.

LCD_MOSI.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI data trace; no controlled-impedance requirement in this revision.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI clock; keep away from the microphone block and route over continuous ground.

LCD_LEDA.rationale: Resistor-limited LCD backlight current is below 120 mA; ordinary 0.5 mm power routing is sufficient for this short run.

MIC_RAW.rationale: ZTS6216 analog output before AC coupling.

MIC_AC.rationale: AC-coupled microphone signal biased at VBIAS.

VBIAS.rationale: Filtered 1.65 V virtual ground for the preamplifier.

MIC_FB.rationale: TLV9061 feedback node; minimize loop area.

MIC_AMP.rationale: Amplified microphone signal before anti-alias resistor.

MIC_ADC.rationale: Filtered ADC input to XIAO D8.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_CENTER
stitchingVias.rationale: Connect the continuous top GND plane to the main bottom GND region at a routed-geometry-clear board-center location.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_1
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 1 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 2.91 mm.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_2
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 2 near C7 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 0.69 mm.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_3
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 3 near C2 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 0.87 mm.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_J1_ESCAPE
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge the diagnosed narrow J1 pin-2 B.Cu escape lobe to the continuous top GND plane; 0.4/0.3 mm is required by the 0.40 mm-wide filled corridor.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_5
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 5 near R4 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 0.68 mm.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_6
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 6 near C5 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 0.49 mm.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BOTTOM_REGION_7
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridge diagnosed B.Cu filled region 7 near U2 to the continuous top GND plane; polygon interior clearance is 0.69 mm.

keepouts.name: U1_ANTENNA_COPPER_KEEPOUT
keepouts.rationale: Keep carrier copper clear beneath the XIAO ESP32S3 antenna end.
